description: Overstroming - Overstromingsbeeld regionale keringen (2021) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodata.zuid-holland.nl. This map shows the floodable area and maximum water depths that can occur after a breakthrough of regional flood defences. Regional flood defences include bosom quays, polder quays, boulders along regional rivers, canals and compartmentalisation dikes. Regional districts are under the control of the province. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Flood - Flood image of regional barriers (2021)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Regionale waterkeringen, Klimaateffectatlas, Overstroming. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, ATOM. The listing shows 2021-02-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
